title: 第23章 你们的努力本座看到了第24章 清点与邀请
lines: 太虚神光所化的金色光线，正以超越凡俗想象的速度掠过苍茫山林，朝着坠星山脉深处的仙门据点返回。
光线之中，姜望心念微动，眼前浮现出唯有他自己能见的淡蓝色光幕。
【境界：练气期四层】
“练气四层了。”
姜望心中了然。
此行伏龙城，算上路途和停留，共计五日。
期间虽未刻意修炼，但太初道体自行吐纳灵气未曾停歇，加之城主府为示好，顿顿供应的猛兽肉，都蕴含充沛气血精华。
两者叠加，从三层突破至四层也算是水到渠成。
体魄与根骨各增长20点，神念亦提升1点。
单论肉身基础，已堪比练气期八层的后期修士。
审视完自身境界，他收敛心神，目光投向下方。
远处，那片熟悉的轮廓已隐约可见。
金光敛去，姜望身形稳稳落于仙门据点中央的出生点水晶塔旁。
落地的瞬间，他便敏锐地察觉到，此地与他五天前离开相比，似乎有了不小的变化。
“门主！
您回来了！”
三道带着惊喜的呼喊声几乎同时响起。
只见剑斩红尘、琉璃仙梦和莽穿地球三人，正从不同的方向快步跑来，脸上都带着难以抑制的兴奋和期待。
他们可就等着这一刻邀功请赏呢。
姜望微微颔首，目光平静地扫过三人：“看来这几日，尔等并未懈怠。”
“那是自然！”
莽穿地球嗓门最大，率先上前，指着据点外围那些简陋的绊索和陷坑，语气带着几分骄傲：
“门主您看，这是我弄的防御工事，虽然粗糙，但预警和拖延点时间肯定没问题！”
他又指了指不远处几个硕大的原木水缸：
“还有那些水缸，都是我亲手凿的，现在每天的打水任务我包了，保证据点用水充足！”
姜望顺着他所指看去，那些防御设施在他眼中形同虚设，莫说修士，便是来个身手敏捷些的凡俗武夫，恐怕也难起作用。
至于打水……他若需要，效率何止百倍。
不过，他并未出言打击，只是淡淡点头。
莽穿地球见门主反应平淡，连忙又补充道：
“对了门主，我在探索时，还发现不少林子里的个别树木，都硬得离谱，斧头都很难砍动，我觉得可能是好东西，都做了标记！”
说着，他还指了指就在不远处的其中一棵。
姜望神识微动，略一探查，眼中倒是露出一丝微不可察的讶色。
“铁木，质地坚韧，蕴含微弱木属灵气，勉强可归为半灵木材，可用于制作一些坚固的凡器或低级器物部件，也可作为低级阵法的辅助材料。”
姜望给出了评价：“虽然按你所说，分布零散，数量不多，但确有一定价值。”
content_en:
The golden light transformed by Taixu Divine Light is passing through the vast mountains and forests at a speed beyond ordinary imagination, returning towards the Immortal Sect stronghold deep in the Falling Star Mountains.
In the light, Jiang Wang's thoughts moved slightly, and a light blue light curtain that only he could see appeared in front of his eyes.
[Realm: Fourth level of Qi training period]
[Physique: 90]
【Root bone: 90】
[Spiritual Thought: 9]
"I've reached the fourth level of Qi training."
Jiang Wang understood clearly.
This trip to Fulong City, including the journey and stops, lasted five days in total.
Although there was no deliberate practice during this period, the Taoist body of Taichu never stopped breathing out spiritual energy on its own. In addition, as a sign of goodwill from the city lord's palace, the beast meat supplied by Dundun contained abundant energy and blood essence.
The two are superimposed, and breaking through from the third level to the fourth level is a matter of course.
The body and bones each increase by 20 points, and the mind also increases by 1 point.
In terms of physical foundation alone, it is comparable to a late-stage monk at the eighth level of Qi training.
After examining his own realm, he gathered his thoughts and cast his gaze downwards.
In the distance, the familiar outline is vaguely visible.
The golden light faded away, and Jiang Wang's figure landed steadily next to the birth point crystal tower in the center of the Xianmen stronghold.
The moment he landed, he was keenly aware that this place seemed to have changed a lot compared to when he left five days ago.
"Master!
You are back! "
Three shouts of surprise sounded almost simultaneously.
I saw Jian Zhan Hongchen, Liuli Xianmeng and Mang Chuan Earth, running quickly from different directions, with uncontrollable excitement and anticipation on their faces.
They were just waiting for this moment to take credit and reward.
Jiang Wang nodded slightly and glanced at the three of them calmly: "It seems that you have not been slacking off in the past few days."
"That's natural!"
Mang Chuan Earth had the loudest voice and took the lead to step forward, pointing to the crude trip wires and traps on the outside of the stronghold, with a bit of pride in his tone:
"Master, you see, this is the fortification I built. Although it is rough, it is definitely no problem to give early warning and delay for a while!"
He pointed to several large log water tanks not far away:
"And those water tanks were all made by me. Now I'm responsible for fetching water every day to ensure that there is enough water at every location!"
Jiang Wang looked along what he pointed at, and in his eyes, those defensive facilities were useless. Not to mention the monks, even a more agile ordinary warrior would probably have difficulty in being effective.
As for fetching water... if he needs it, the efficiency will be more than a hundred times higher.
However, he did not say any words to attack, but just nodded lightly.
Seeing the sect master's lackluster reaction, Mang Chuan Di Di quickly added:
"By the way, Master, when I was exploring, I also found that many individual trees in the forest are extremely hard and difficult to cut with an axe. I thought they might be good things, so I have marked them!"
As he spoke, he pointed to one of the trees not far away.
Jiang Wang's consciousness moved slightly, and after a brief exploration, there was a trace of imperceptible surprise in his eyes.
"Iron wood has a tough texture and contains a weak wood spiritual energy. It can barely be classified as a semi-spiritual wood. It can be used to make some strong mortal weapons or low-level artifact components, and can also be used as an auxiliary material for low-level formations."
Jiang Wang gave his evaluation: "Although as you said, it is scattered and not in large quantity, it does have a certain value."
